fields.name: Character
fields.evidence: Same head as the confirmed eoc::analytics::EventCombatTurnComponent (m_CharacterHandle at +0). Live: client 0x01400001000001FE-like, server 0x01800001000007C3-like values (entity handles of the two worlds). RecordCombatStart (EoCClient.dll+0xD36CA0) gets the resolved character as a separate argument.

fields.name: Faction
fields.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0xD36CA0 ecl::GameAnalyticsSystem::RecordCombatStart: ls::Guid::ToString(+8) -> "faction_id", FactionContainer lookup of +8 -> "faction_name". Live: 5 distinct 16-byte values, identical on client and server.

fields.name: CombatGroupId

fields.name: CombatTeam
